intent: Record which agent drafted each proposed element.

edit.summary:
I made two proposals in the `authoring` domain, and both were accepted with 0 issues. I left `delivery` unchanged.

- **`objects.Element`** (proposal `E-19-ccc585f7`): I added an optional string property `drafted_by`, which holds the name of the agent that drafted the element. The rest of the object is as it was.
- **`actions.propose_element`** (proposal `E-19-857e3b38`): I added an optional `drafted_by` param. I added an effect that sets `target.drafted_by` from it, and the existing effects are kept. I also extended the description to mention this.

I made `drafted_by` optional so that existing callers and fixtures keep working. That means an agent can still propose an element without naming itself. If you want it enforced, it would need to be a required param, which could break current proposals. I also didn't use `actor.id`, because I couldn't confirm it identifies the agent rather than the owner it acts for.
